name: Walker X
specs_note: OWNER-APPROVED 2026-10-31 (Robert Konecny, in thread; PR #222); unpublished, publication is a separate decision. RETRIEVAL: AUTOMATED weekly new-robot scan 2026-10-31 (HO-DATA-STANDING); values verbatim from https://www.ubtrobot.com/en/humanoid/products/walker-x. Not human-verified. Page meta description: 'UBTECH Walker X is a next-generation humanoid robot designed for AI research, smart services, and human-robot interaction. Discover advanced mobility, intelligent perception, and real-world applications.' Specification values were not retrievable from the static page, so all specs are null. Relationship to catalogued Walker S1/S2/Tienkung is not stated on the page and is not inferred. SELLER ENRICHMENT 2026-10-31: height, weight, mobility and a US price from the RobotLAB listing https://www.robotlab.com/store/walker-humanoid-service-robot/ ('Model / platform: Walker X (research edition)'); the seller says it is its research-edition offering, so the edition match to UBTECH's Walker X page is unconfirmed. The RobotLAB page contradicts itself on price: $250,000 in 'Starting at', the spec table and the comparison table, but $960,000 in two prose passages; both recorded, $250,000 used as the offer price (structured fields), owner to confirm.
